concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs constitution.md Principle VII / Data Hygiene
concerns.text: No task implements checksumming of raw Landsat scenes or any file under data/, nor recording checksums in the state YAML artifact_hashes map. Constitution Principle VII ('Each scene MUST have its checksum recorded') and the Data Hygiene section ('Every file under data/ is checksummed') are mandatory project requirements with zero task coverage; plan.md's Constitution Check marks them PASS but no task substantiates this. Add a checksum step to T002/T005.
Constitution Principle I requires 'Random seeds MUST be pinned in code/'. No task mentions pinning random seeds (T001 pins dependencies only). Add seed-pinning to T001 or T006 (model fitting).

Tasks reference 'specs/.../contracts/timeseries.schema.yaml' and 'specs/001-ecotourism-regeneration/quickstart.md' while the actual contracts live under 'specs/001-investigating-the-potential-benefits-of/contracts/'. The two spec-directory names are used interchangeably throughout tasks.md; an implementer following T002's path may not find the schema. Reconcile to the canonical directory path.

FR-006 requires the final JSON report to contain confidence intervals. T008 writes CIs to data/results/lmm_results.json but the FinalReport contract fields it validates against (regression_coefficients as a bare dict) define no CI field, so the CI requirement is not verifiable in final_report.json. Either extend the contract or have T008 explicitly include CIs in regression_coefficients entries.
